summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work, an agentic feature that can act across apps and files and persist on a task for hours to complete a goal.

mechanisms.reason: The described agent taking action across apps and files for extended periods represents a shift from seat-based tool use to autonomous task completion.
mechanisms.quote: ChatGPT Work is an agent that can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.

mechanisms.reason: An agent that persists on tasks for hours implies sustained multi-step inference calls, increasing aggregate token volume.
mechanisms.quote: stay with a project for hours if needed
